'''March 2001 Minneapolis tournament (20 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 20 March 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1935">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-21-it-can-be-a-little-rough-in-mirkwood-mnd1935/ it-can-be-a-little-rough-in-mirkwood-mn], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 21 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-21-it-can-be-a-little-rough-in-mirkwood-mnd1935/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
